les.title: 🏋 Apna game review: blunders
les.sub: Engine tumhare game ki badi galtiyan dhundega, har galti ek card
yaad: Galti ka card baar baar aayega jab tak pakka na ho.

steps.md:
Lichess ya Chess.com par khela koi game (PGN) yahan daalo. Engine **blunders** (badi galtiyan) dhundega. Har galti ek **card** banegi: abhi solve karo, aur kuch din baad review mein dobara aayegi.

Har haare game ke baad yeh lesson dobara kholo (lesson list se).

les.title: 🏋 Apna game review: CCT se galti samjho
les.sub: Mistakes bhi, aur har galti ki wajah (check, capture, threat)
yaad: Galti ki wajah likho: kya miss hua?
Sabse zyada wali wajah par practice.

steps.md: Ab engine **mistakes** bhi dhundega. Har card solve karne ke baad batao **kya miss hua**: check, capture, threat, ya apna piece latka. App ginti rakhega ki tumhari sabse zyada galti kahan hoti hai.

les.title: 🏋 Apna game review: pehle khud, phir engine
les.sub: Pro tareeka: khud analyse karo, engine se milao, category banao
yaad: Galtiyon ki category: tactic, blunder, time, plan, endgame.

steps.md: Analysis lesson ka tareeka: **pehle khud** apni galat chaalein chuno, phir engine. App batayega kitni galtiyan tumne khud pakdi aur kitni chhoot gayi. Phir har galti ki **category** (tactic, blunder, time, plan, endgame).

les.title: 🏋 Apna game review: GM level
les.sub: Inaccuracies bhi, 5 cards tak, deep engine
yaad: Chhoti galtiyan bhi jodkar game haarte hain.
Har hafte kam se kam 3 games review.

steps.md: GM level review: engine **inaccuracies** bhi pakdega (chhoti galtiyan), aur sabse badi 5 cards banengi. Pehle khud, phir engine, phir category. Training plan: har hafte kam se kam 3 games.
